rule: Do not sign a profile until datum, boundary authority, component policy, and final distortion checks are approved.

profiles.note: Better first-pass scale result than the existing EQC candidate. Confirm an SRGI2013-based LCC before release.
Reject the first EQC candidate. Review PRS92 or another official datum and island-component behavior.
Keep the existing VN-2000 LCC candidate unless a datum-correct alternative clearly improves it.
Reject centered EQC. Review the national datum and the long north-south boundary.
Review the national datum and coastal/island treatment before signing.
Test Peninsular Malaysia and Borneo separately. Keep one namespace unless cross-component behavior becomes unacceptable.
